what_this_is_not: R values are copied from the tracked fixture. Julia values are computed fresh by tools/true_parity_julia_receipts.jl, which repeats the computation of the cited twin test with the same inputs and settings; R was not run and is not recomputed here.

cases.quantity: mean of the bootstrap time_estimate distribution, Julia vs R (n_boot = 200)
cases.julia_source: mean of GLLVModels.bootstrap_temporal(fit; n_boot = 200, seed = 260931).time_estimate over converged replicates, as at test/test_temporal_helpers.jl:244
cases.note: bootstrap_temporal is stochastic, so the test's acceptance is statistical, and this case records exactly that band. n_boot = 200, seed = 260931, fit sim_indep__indep__ar1; 200 of 200 Julia replicates converged (R: 200). Tolerance is the test's 4 standard errors of the difference of means, se = sqrt(sd_R^2 / n_R + sd_J^2 / n_J), evaluated from this run (0.046109911176139495).

cases.quantity: log sd of the bootstrap time_estimate distribution, Julia vs R (n_boot = 200)
cases.julia_source: log(sd of GLLVModels.bootstrap_temporal(...).time_estimate over converged replicates), as at test/test_temporal_helpers.jl:245
cases.note: bootstrap_temporal is stochastic, so the test's acceptance is statistical, and this case records exactly that band. n_boot = 200, seed = 260931, fit sim_indep__indep__ar1; 200 of 200 Julia replicates converged (R: 200). The test asserts the ratio sd_J / sd_R lies in [0.75, 1/0.75]; on the log scale that is |log sd_J - log sd_R| <= log(1/0.75) = 0.28768207245178085, the same band.
